:data.azurerm_policy_definition.external_lookup reads Policy Definitions at Management Group scope, but has no dependency on the Management Group deployments (:resource.time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group). On a first apply, Azure Management Groups are not immediately readable/replicated after creation (this is why the module chains time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group before all policy resources), so the data source can fail with a "not found" error before the Management Group hierarchy exists. An explicit depends_on on time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group is required.

:data.azurerm_policy_set_definition.external_lookup reads Policy Set Definitions at Management Group scope, but has no dependency on the Management Group deployments (:resource.time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group). Management Group lookups can fail during the first apply due to Azure's propagation delay after Management Group creation (the reason the module inserts time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group before policy/role resources). An explicit depends_on on time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group is required.
